emerging_watch: Watching AI Infrastructure for a leadership handoff to Cybersecurity: if AI Infrastructure's durability_bar stays below 0.70 while Cybersecurity holds breadth above 0.9 and durability above 0.80 for 10 consecutive sessions, that would confirm a shift of durable leadership away from the current top-rank name. Alternatively, if AI Infrastructure's breadth recovers above 0.85 with durability crossing back above 0.75, the watch retires.
